# primitives

## Do not add a new top-level primitive without approval

This list is already too long to scan. Never create
`plugins/primitives/plugins/<new-name>/` on your own initiative — ask first. Prefer
nesting the new plugin under the one it is built from, or grouping it with its
relatives under an umbrella.

<!-- AUTOGENERATED:BEGIN — do not edit; regenerated by `./singularity build` -->
